name: 29-background-multi
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } .multi { height: 80px; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 13px; color: #fff; background-image: linear-gradient(0deg, #ff0000, #0000ff), linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff00, #000000); background-repeat: no-repeat, repeat; background-position: left top, right top; background-size: 50% 100%, 25% 50%; }
html: 两层背景：红蓝渐变 no-repeat + 绿黑渐变 repeat
